title: Basics
description: The fundamentals of radio communication: the phonetic alphabet, numbers, frequencies and standard words.

title: Traffic Pattern
description: Learn the circuit legs and make the radio calls of a circuit, with and without ATC.

title: VFR — Uncontrolled
description: VFR flight from an uncontrolled airfield (Piła): self-announcing, A/G radio and FIS en route.

title: VFR — Controlled
description: VFR flight at a controlled aerodrome (Poznań): clearances and readbacks with Ground and Tower.

title: IFR
description: Instrument flight communications: clearances, departures, approaches.
